articles.title: Interpol Recovers $105M in African Cybercrime Sweep That Shut Illegal Crypto Mines
articles.snippet: Operation Serengeti III led to 1,462 arrests across 21 countries, while Angolan police seized more than 2,000 crypto mining devices.

articles.title: Italy Busts Mafia 'Secret Bank' That Laundered Money Through Crypto, Seizes $24M
articles.snippet: Police say a car-rental firm near Milan was an underground bank for 'Ndrangheta and Camorra figures, moving money abroad and into crypto.

articles.title: Chinese Prosecutors Seek to Confiscate $5.1B in Bitcoin Seized by UK in Qian Case
articles.snippet: A Tianjin court will hear the application after a six-month notice period, while a parallel fight over the same coins continues in London.
